value.subject: Air freight quote request to JFK
value.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Could you please quote the fastest air freight option to JFK (New York, US)? The shipment will be ready for pickup at our site in 61018 (Bad Homburg), Germany, on 2026-11-25. Please arrange trucking from our site to the departure airport.

The shipment consists of 6 pieces of precision instruments, with a gross weight of 1233 kg and a total volume of 10.78 cbm.

Please provide your all-in price in EUR, including pickup and trucking, and confirm the earliest available arrival at JFK.

Thank you in advance.

Kind regards
Anna Sonnberg
Head of Purchasing and Logistics
Sonnberg Kaffeeroesterei GmbH
